notes.setup: This test uses the multibrand 'mablmultibrand1' on the staging environment
expectedFeatures: Multibrand API returns JSON configuration with name, overrideCMSHost, metadata, title, description
CMS career site renders with header (banner, nav1, nav2), body (heading), footer (copyright)
Main domain multibrand home renders with language selector, header, body, footer
Jobs page supports keyword search with URL parameter 'keywords'
Jobs page supports location search with URL parameters 'location', 'stretch', 'stretchUnit'
Jobs page supports category filters with URL parameter 'categories'
Jobs page supports sort with URL parameters 'sortBy' and 'descending'
Jobs page supports items per page with URL parameter 'limit'
Jobs page supports pagination with URL parameter 'page'
All filter/search actions update URL parameters correctly
Remove buttons clear filters and restore original results
